* Overview & Architecture

WTQ is a small wrapper that gives any terminal a Quake-style drop-down behaviour: a global hotkey slides the terminal in from the top of the screen and slides it back out when dismissed.

**Why WTQ?**
We use WTQ instead of standard tiling to provide *frictionless, instantaneous* access to a terminal without disturbing the Komorebi window layout. It is permanently pinned to =Win + ~=.

**Architecture: WezTerm & Komorebi**
This config attaches WTQ to a =wezterm-gui.exe= process launched with the =--class QuakeTerm= flag.
Because WezTerm is a native Win32 app, the =QuakeTerm= class is set at process birth. Komorebi reads this class instantly and ignores the window, preventing the drop-down from ever being tiled.

**Window Matching**
WTQ uses =WindowClass= = ^QuakeTerm$= to match the dedicated quake instance.
Because WezTerm applies =--class= at process birth, the class is set before
WTQ even sees the window — no race condition. A regular (non-quake) WezTerm
has a different class and will never be hijacked.

**Dynamic Geometry**
The top-level terminal =VerticalOffset= value is kept in sync with =komorebi-bar= visibility:
- Bar *shown* (default at login): =VerticalOffset = 25= (bar is 32 px tall, leaving 7 px gap).
- Bar *hidden*: =VerticalOffset = 0= (terminal slides to the very top edge).

The =toggle-komorebi-bar.ps1= script updates that top-level terminal offset and restarts WTQ automatically when toggling the bar.

Reference: [[https://github.com/flyingpie/windows-terminal-quake][WTQ GitHub repository]]

* Configuration

** Schema

The =$schema= key enables auto-complete and validation in editors that
support JSON Schema (VS Code, Cursor, etc.).

** WezTerm App

WTQ launches =wezterm-gui start --class QuakeTerm= and attaches via window
class (=WindowClass= = ^QuakeTerm$=), which is set at process birth.
=WindowTitleOverride= renames the window to "Quake" as a visual label;
Komorebi ignores the window by class, not title.

=AlwaysOnTop= keeps the terminal floating above all tiled windows including
those managed by komorebi, so it never gets covered mid-session.

=Opacity= at 90 % keeps background context visible while maintaining legibility.

** Geometry

| Setting                  | Value  | Reason                                    |
|--------------------------+--------+-------------------------------------------|
| =HorizontalScreenCoverage= | =100=  | Full width — same as a maximised window   |
| =HorizontalAlign=          | Center | Fallback alignment (irrelevant at 100 %)  |
| =VerticalScreenCoverage=   | =48=   | ~half the screen height, comfortable read |
| =VerticalOffset=           | =25=   | Clears the 32 px komorebi-bar             |

=ShowUiOnStart= is false — the WTQ tray icon is hidden at startup. Access
settings through the tray if needed.

** Full Config

#+begin_src json
{
  "$schema": "wtq.schema.json",
  "Apps": [
    {
      "Name": "WezTerm",
      "Hotkeys": [
        {
          "Modifiers": "Super",
          "KeyChar": "`"
        }
      ],
      "FileName": "C:\\Users\\Namef\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\WezTerm\\wezterm-gui.exe",
      "Arguments": "start --class QuakeTerm",
      "ProcessName": "^wezterm-gui$",
      "WindowClass": "^QuakeTerm$",
      "WindowTitleOverride": "Quake",
      "HideOnFocusLost": "UnlessFocusChangedScreen",
      "AlwaysOnTop": true,
      "Opacity": 90
    }
  ],
  "ShowUiOnStart": false,
  "HorizontalScreenCoverage": 101,
  "HorizontalAlign": "Center",
  "VerticalScreenCoverage": 48,
  "VerticalOffset": 27,
  "AnimationDurationMs": 0
}
#+end_src
